title: Accurate Wither Storm Mod
description: "There's nothing left up there! Nothing but that Wither Storm..."
body:
This pack aims to make Cracker's Wither Storm Mod more accurate to Minecraft: Story Mode. The pack changes:
- **The Command Block tools and the Amulet.** All these items have been modified to make them look like the ones from Minecraft: Story Mode.
- **The textures of the tainted blocks.** Tainted blocks now look like their older variants, accurate to MC:SM.
- **The textures of the Wither Storm and the Command Block.** The Storm and the Command Block are more accurate to Minecraft: Story Mode.

Credits to:
- **LucasDotje** for using some of his pack's textures.
- **Antimo & Welles** for using music from MC:SM.

Cracker's Wither Storm Mod is **REQUIRED** for this pack to work.

Older versions will **_NOT_** be updated.

As of the newest update, the pack is compatible with Fresh Wither Storm versions 2.2+.

Totally Accurate Wither Storm Mod's compatibility pack was removed for animation issues.


**_RESOURCE PACK ORDER:_**
Enable AWSM before FWS, then enable AWSM x FWS compatibility pack.
